# Adoption templates

These worksheets belong to the product built from the scaffold. Fill them with
reviewed facts; they are not claims about a deployment of this repository.

- [Architecture decision](architecture-decision.md)
- [Deployment planning](deployment-planning.md)
- [Example OpenAPI](examples/openapi.json) and [example Swagger page](examples/swagger.html)

The API example contains placeholder hosts, JWT authentication, and paths not
implemented by the scaffold. Do not use it as an integration contract.
